title: The Galois-Symmetrized Arithmetic Cycle Theorem: Rationality of Subtractive Spectral Cycles via Galois-Orbit Sifting and Arakelov Heights
description: Formal Lean 4 machine-certified proof and numerical verification of the Galois-Symmetrized Arithmetic Cycle Theorem, establishing that Galois orbit averaging produces algebraic cycles defined over Q with rational Chow class. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
